capabilities: Toggle fold on top-level list items in the current note
Toggle fold on every nested list level recursively
Detect current fold state and fold or unfold accordingly
Assign hotkeys to the fold commands
extras: Requires Obsidian desktop because it uses CodeMirror 6 editor APIs; not reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Obsidian's built-in "Fold all" command folds both headings and lists. This plugin gives you list-specific folding
motivation: The README implies the author wanted list-specific folding that the built-in command does not offer.
problem: Obsidian's built-in Fold all command folds both headings and lists, so headings cannot be kept open when working with nested lists.
summary: Adds two commands that fold or unfold list items in a note while leaving headings expanded.
